The worst place ever seen in my life. I'm sharing my personal experience I had when I attended one marriage here about ten days back. I stayed there for three days and found that it was the greatest mistake of the host who got booked this resort for the marriage of his daughter. There was no cleanliness in and around the resort. The water logging within and around the resort was found.
In washrooms handwash containers are there but no liquid. Water logging in the wash basins and on floors, no house keeping staff available for cleaning. Lots of flies in dining areas and mosquitoes at night. The dirtiest place to have any function.
In rooms, TVs and intercoms not working, just show pieces. Rooms were cleaned on request only throughout our stay. No Managerial staff was there to whom we should complain. In the name of security we found no security guard. All the rooms were being opened with master key only. No room keys were made available.
The most disappointing is that we had given one Insulin injection pen to the staff for keeping in the fridge. The next day when we asked for, the pen was not traceable and the diabetic patient was not given insulin for two days.
In view of the above I strongly express my dissatisfaction and suggest not to think of any function here till all things are put to order.
